name: jac-docs
description: Answer Jac questions from the official docs site with sources

docs.description: answer a question from docs.jaseci.org with links: /docs how do I persist nodes
docs.prompt:
Answer from the official Jac documentation: $ARGS

1. Check the installed guides first (jac tool, action "guide").
2. If that isn't enough, fetch https://docs.jaseci.org/llms.txt to find the right pages, then fetch those pages (several at once).
3. Answer concisely with a small example. If you write example code, verify it with `jac check`.
4. End with the links you used.
